title: Implement parallel frame encoding
description:
Encode multiple frames concurrently:
- Worker threads acquire encoder from pool
- Each frame gets sequence number for ordering
- Encode opus_encode() in parallel
- Store encoded_frame_t with: data, length, sequence_number
- Push to reordering buffer

Pattern:
  frame = queue.pop()
  encoder = pool.acquire()
  result = opus_encode(encoder, frame, ...)
  pool.release(encoder)
  reorder_buffer.push(result, seq_num)

Target: 2-4 concurrent encoding operations
close_reason:
Implemented parallel frame encoding infrastructure with:
- encoded_frame_t: holds encoded data, length, sequence number, frame samples
- encoder_work_queue_t: thread-safe MPMC queue for raw audio input
- encoder_reorder_buffer_t: collects encoded frames and reorders by sequence
- Worker threads: acquire encoder from pool, encode, push to reorder buffer
- parallel_encoder_create/destroy/submit/pop/finish API
Files: include/toniefile_encoder.h, src/toniefile_encoder.c

title: Create OGG page write queue
description:
Buffer OGG pages for asynchronous writing:
- ogg_page_queue_t with page data and metadata
- Queue collects pages from ogg_stream_flush()
- Preserves page order for file writes
- Includes SHA1 context pointer for hash updates
- Tracks 4096-byte block boundaries

Data per entry:
- ogg_page header + body copies
- file_pos at time of queuing
- block_num tracking info

Purpose: Decouple OGG generation from disk I/O

title: Add frame reordering buffer
description:
Collect out-of-order encoded frames, emit in sequence:
- Buffer holds encoded_frame_t with sequence numbers
- Waits until next expected sequence arrives
- Emits frames in strict order for OGG packetization
- Handles variable encoding times gracefully

Data structure: Min-heap or sorted buffer by sequence
Output: Sequential stream for ogg_stream_packetin()

Critical: OGG granule positions must be strictly sequential
This component bridges parallel encoding → serial OGG mux
close_reason: Already implemented in toniefile_encoder.c with reorder_buffer_init/push/pop/close functions

title: Implement async writer thread
description:
Background thread for file I/O:
- Consumes from OGG page write queue
- Calls fsWriteFile() for each page
- Updates SHA1 hash in correct order
- Tracks taf_block_num for block boundaries
- Signals completion for toniefile_close()

Constraints:
- SHA1 updates must be sequential
- Block alignment must be preserved
- Must flush queue before file close

Expected gain: 5-15% speedup by overlapping I/O with encoding

- audio_frame_queue_t: ring buffer, head/tail, mutex

Constraint: Must be thread-safe for single producer, single consumer pattern.
